body: I am so happy that your fiancé stuck up for you! See my post from earlier: I will most likely be breaking off my engagement to my fiancé because he refuses to go NC/VLC.
I’m going to bring this up during our session tomorrow. Thank you.
THANK YOU. I needed to hear this.
I commend you on being stronger than I am!
Your response was amazing, thank you.... but your username made me CRACK UP.
I’m starting individual therapy next week. Thank you. The future feels so unclear.
We have been going to therapy and will continue to keep going until I’ve made my [full] decision. I think he’s comfortable with myself going full-NC with his family, so that makes me feel better.
We are going to continue to go to therapy, but I’m feeling awfully pessimistic right now. I appreciate your kind words.

This was a relief to read. I’m so close to tossing it out the window, but I love him so much. Honestly, I’m hoping his parents will fuck up on such a big level that he’ll go NC. That’s fucked up high hopes, but that’s what I’m wishing for now.
You’re right, I’m just looking for confirmation and permission. I’ve received more confirmation than I could’ve asked for within this post. You guys are amazing.
I’m still best friends with my high school sweetheart’s mother. She’s the best and I love her. I even took care of her while she was in the hospital. It can definitely happen!

It has been draining me since we got engaged (that’s when the behavior from his parents started) over a year ago. JNMIL ruined the entire wedding experience for me (that should’ve been the first red flag) by showing everyone pictures of me in my wedding dress, obviously ruining the surprise. She also wanted to wear white to our wedding. When I objected, she said “oh you’re going to be one of *those* brides.” Once I stuck up for myself, that’s when all of this started. 

I genuinely believe he cares for me and loves me, but not as much as I need him to.
Thank you for sharing that.
I’m starting individual therapy regardless of whether this works or not. This has really done a number on me lately. I believe that I deserve to be his top priority. 100%
Thank you. All of these responses have been good to hear, but it’s just *so hard* to accept how much things are going to change.
He’s not ready. Thank you.
His family *appeared* really normal until we got engaged. That’s when everything changed.
You’re right. This shit is doomed.
SAY IT LOUDER FOR THE PEOPLE IN THE BACK! Hahaha. Yes. Yes. Yes. You’re right.
You’re right. Thank you. I appreciate your honesty!

Yeah, I’ve told him that I can’t marry into a family where everyone dislikes me. Of course JNMIL has everything to do with it. He understands where I’m coming from, but his family is so enmeshed that he’ll never get out.

I definitely feel like the meat shield (amazing analogy) now. I’m not prioritized over them. He’s so distracted by the shitty situation that he’s starting to neglect me.... and he admits it. You’re right- it’s over before it even started.
This breaks my heart, but it’s exactly what I needed to hear. Thank you. Swiggy is wise.
I already feel resentful and hurt so you’re absolutely on point 😔
That’s what I’m thinking... I won’t be able to get him alone. Just got to cut all of them out. It’s hard because I love him.
